headline.zh: 为AI智能体配置运行时安全策略
headline.en: Configure runtime security for AI agents

scenario.zh: 您的财务智能体需要访问支付系统,如何在授权操作的同时防止未经批准的转账?
scenario.en: Your finance agent needs payment access. How do you authorize operations while preventing unapproved transfers?

instruction.zh: 选择您的财务智能体可以访问的系统范围
instruction.en: Choose which systems your finance agent can access

label.zh: 仅读取权限:查看账户和发票

output.zh: 智能体可以检索财务数据和生成报告,但无法执行任何交易操作
output.en: Agent can retrieve financial data and generate reports but cannot execute transactions

label.zh: 有限写入:批准500元以下付款

output.zh: 智能体可以处理小额付款,所有较大金额需要人工审批
output.en: Agent can process small payments while larger amounts require human approval

instruction.zh: 决定何时需要人工介入智能体的操作
instruction.en: Decide when human intervention is required for agent actions

output.zh: 重复性任务如定期账单支付自动处理,异常操作触发审批流程
output.en: Recurring tasks like regular bill payments auto-process while anomalies trigger review

output.zh: 每笔交易在执行前暂停,向指定审批人发送通知等待授权
output.en: Every transaction pauses before execution and notifies designated approvers for authorization

instruction.zh: 查看安全平台标记的智能体操作并做出决策
instruction.en: Examine agent operations flagged by the security platform and make decisions

output.zh: 操作被拦截:供应商未在授权列表且金额超出阈值,需要财务主管审核
output.en: Operation blocked: vendor not on approved list and amount exceeds threshold, requires CFO review

label.zh: 批量修改400个客户折扣率
label.en: Bulk modify discount rates for 400 customers

output.zh: 操作被拦截:批量更改超出范围,影响范围广泛,建议分批处理并验证
output.en: Operation blocked: bulk changes exceed scope with wide impact, suggest batch processing with verification

instruction.zh: 评估不同配置下的智能体行为和风险控制
instruction.en: Evaluate agent behavior and risk control under different configurations

output.zh: 智能体处理更多常规任务,审批请求减少,但需要密切监控异常模式
output.en: Agent handles more routine tasks with fewer approval requests but requires close anomaly monitoring

label.zh: 严格策略:最小风险暴露

output.zh: 所有关键操作经过人工验证,响应时间较长,但未经授权操作完全受控
output.en: All critical operations verified by humans with longer response time but unauthorized actions fully controlled

takeaway.zh: Kontext让您在释放AI智能体生产力的同时,通过实时策略控制确保关键操作的安全性和可审计性
takeaway.en: Kontext enables AI agent productivity while ensuring critical operation security and auditability through real-time policy control
